Lemma
[Topological ends are essentially thin] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0210 1. ch31:31.42\group Margulis lemma

In a finite-volume hyperbolic manifold, every topological end contains a cofinal $\varepsilon $-thin end, and for sufficiently small $\varepsilon $ every $\varepsilon $-thin end is topological.
